message: The other day, I found myself staring at a half-empty pantry and a fridge that could use a good cleaning. Suddenly, a storm was forecasted for the weekend—cue the mini panic! I took a breath, rummaged through my stash, and managed to whip up a surprisingly decent chili with just a can of beans and some frozen veggies. It felt like a small victory, knowing I was ready for whatever the storm threw our way. Have you ever had a last-minute meal save the day?
